definitions.gloss: president, head (of a political party or major organization)
definitions.explanation: The top leader of a political party, central bank, or other major organization. In Japan, most prominently used for the president of the Liberal Democratic Party (LDP), who typically becomes prime minister.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{総裁|そうさい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{選|えら}ばれた→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
examples.english: A new party president was elected.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自民党|じみんとう}→自民党：28140_jimintou⟧{総裁|そうさい}⟦{選挙|せんきょ}→選挙：03303_senkyo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧⟦{行|おこな}われる→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: The LDP presidential election will be held next month.

examples.japanese: {日本銀行|にほんぎんこう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{総裁|そうさい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{金融|きんゆう}{政策|せいさく}→金融政策：18097_kinyuuseisaku⟧⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦{記者会見|きしゃかいけん}→記者会見：19954_kishakaiken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}った→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: The governor of the Bank of Japan held a press conference on monetary policy.
examples.notes: When referring to a central bank, {総裁|そうさい} is typically translated as 'governor' in English.

notes:
USAGE:
In Japanese politics, ⟦{自民党|じみんとう}→自民党：28140_jimintou⟧{総裁|そうさい} (LDP president) is distinct from ⟦{首相|しゅしょう}→首相：03217_shushou⟧/⟦{総理大臣|そうりだいじん}→総理大臣：15205_souridaijin⟧ (prime minister), though the LDP president usually becomes PM. For central banks, the English equivalent is typically 'governor' rather than 'president'.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {総裁|そうさい}⟦{選挙|せんきょ}→選挙：03303_senkyo⟧/{総裁|そうさい}{選|せん}: party presidential election
- {党|とう}{総裁|そうさい}: party president
- ⟦{日銀|にちぎん}→日銀：19311_nichigin⟧{総裁|そうさい}: Bank of Japan governor
- {総裁|そうさい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{就任|しゅうにん}→就任：12368_shuunin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to assume the presidency
